skills.name: Corkage Fee
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gallagher's ATK to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: Nectar Blitz
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gallagher's ATK to one designated enemy target. Reduces the target's ATK by #2[f1]%, lasting for #3[i] turn(s).

skills.name: Special Brew
skills.desc: Immediately heals a target ally for #1[i] HP.

skills.name: Champagne Etiquette
skills.desc: Inflicts Besotted on all enemies, lasting for #2[i] turn(s). At the same time, deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gallagher's ATK to all enemies, and enhances his next Basic ATK to Nectar Blitz.

skills.name: Tipsy Tussle
skills.desc: The Besotted state makes targets receive #1[f1]% more Break DMG. Every time a Besotted target gets attacked by an ally, the attacking ally's HP is restored by #2[i].

skills.name: Artisan Elixir
skills.desc: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, inflicts Besotted on all enemies, lasting for #1[i] turn(s). And deals Fire DMG equal to #2[i]% of Gallagher's ATK to all enemies.

passives.name: Novel Concoction
passives.desc: Increases this unit's Outgoing Healing by an amount equal to 50% of Break Effect, up to a maximum Outgoing Healing increase of 75%.

passives.name: Organic Yeast
passives.desc: After using the Ultimate, immediately advances action for this unit by 100%.

passives.name: Bottoms Up
passives.desc: When Gallagher uses Nectar Blitz to attack Besotted enemies, the HP Restore effect of his Talent will also apply to teammates for this time.
